incident-bot: [ALERT] Node group 'inference-pool-a' showing repeated container exits on paged-attn alloc; OOMs increasing over last 30m. Severity: P1-candidate.
elena (oncall): saw this alert ~5m ago. noticed slow memory climb on kv-cache metrics before first exit.
matt (runtime): I have traces from one failed container - looks like fragmentation + failed cudaMalloc near end of trace. grabbing logs.
ravi (sre): is this affecting user-facing requests? any 5xx spikes?
elena (oncall): 5xx's started ~10m ago, small but consistent. Some long-tail latency on chat endpoints.
sophie (prodops): flagged to CS — customers on Dedicated might see degraded throughput. @customer-support please prep a status brief.
customer-support: acknowledged, prepping a short blurb. Will update customers if we escalate.
matt (runtime): log snippet from one crash:
```
[2026-03-15T03:41:12Z] runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T03:41:12Z] allocator: paged-attn: attempted alloc 64MB, available 12MB
[2026-03-15T03:41:12Z] kv-cache: current pages=12429, fragmented_pages=18%
[stack trace trimmed]
```
elena (oncall): thanks. any recent deploys to that pool?
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T02:58 by @matt completed to inference-pool-a (model-serving v2.3.1). No rollbacks.
matt (runtime): that deploy included paged-attn allocator tune: lower page compaction frequency (to reduce CPU overhead). Might be related.
ravi (sre): compaction delay + long-lived KV pages could increase fragmentation. If compaction deferred, eviction pressure grows.
elena (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas? throttle new requests? drain?
sophie (prodops): we can switch traffic to fallback region but that'll add latency for customers. Prefer in-place fixes first.
matt (runtime): two quick mitigations: 1) force an immediate compaction/gc on the allocator; 2) reduce per-request batch_size across pool to reduce working set.
ravi (sre): we can also temporarily disable page prefetching which reduces concurrent resident pages.
elena (oncall): can you push a gc trigger? risk of CPU spike?
matt (runtime): GC will spike CPU for a short period but avoids OOMs. I'll push a GC job to pool.
[~2m later]
matt (runtime): GC job started:
```
cmd: runtime_ctl --pool inference-pool-a --action force_compact_kv
status: started on 8 nodes
```
elena (oncall): monitoring. I'll hold off draining.
[~3m later]
matt (runtime): compaction finished on 6/8 nodes, two nodes still completing. Fragmentation dropped 18% -> 6% on completed nodes. Memory pressure falling.
ravi (sre): great. nodes with compaction completed have no new OOMs. The two slow nodes show continued creeping due to stale resident pages. Suggest we restart the agent on those two.
sophie (prodops): agree, rolling restart of the agent on the two slow nodes. Can we do one node at a time?
matt (runtime): yes. I'll schedule one-node restart to avoid impact.
elena (oncall): go ahead on node-7, then node-12. Watch 5xx.
matt (runtime): restarting agent on node-7 now.
[~1m]
incident-bot: node-7 agent restart completed. Container restarted.
matt (runtime): node-7 back and compaction state normal. memory settled. Proceeding with node-12.
[~2m]
incident-bot: node-12 agent restart completed.
elena (oncall): all nodes showing fragmentation <8% now. No further OOMs in last 10m. 5xx rate returning to baseline.
sophie (prodops): returning traffic to normal routing. No customers reported errors yet. Will continue to monitor for 30m.
customer-support: prepared customer message if needed; holding.
matt (runtime): follow-ups: revert the compaction frequency change in the next patch, add a safety guard that forces compaction when fragmentation >12%, and add a KV-cache eviction metric alert.
ravi (sre): also add a synthetic test that simulates long-sequence workloads to exercise page churn overnight.
elena (oncall): incident classification: memory creep due to compaction tuning + paged-attn behavior -> fragmentation cascade -> OOMs on two nodes. Live mitigation: forced compaction + node agent restarts avoided full cluster outage.
sophie (prodops): recommend P1 -> P2 after 1hr stable. will draft post-incident customer note.
matt (runtime): saving logs and trace bundle to /var/log/incidents/3790001234/trace_bundle.tar.gz
```
ls -lh /var/log/incidents/3790001234/
-rw-r--r-- 1 runtime 2.1G trace_bundle.tar.gz
```
elena (oncall): nice. I'll hand this over to the postmortem owners. @matt please include timeline and config diff. @ravi add remediation runbook steps.
matt (runtime): will do. rough timeline:
- 03:21 first metric drift observed
- 03:36 repeated container exits begin
- 03:41 first cudaMalloc OOM logged
- 03:47 forced compaction kicked off
- 03:53 node restarts finished, metrics stabilized
- 04:10 monitoring confirms stable
ravi (sre): I'll follow up with infra changes: add compaction guard, synthetic test, and change default compaction back.
sophie (prodops): I'll prepare customer outreach template and coordinate severity downgrade if stable for 60m.
elena (oncall): closing on-call thread — will link postmortem here when ready. Thanks everyone. :heart:
customer-support: ready to send template if you approve.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Incident 3790001234 marked resolved by elena (oncall) at 3790001299.
